title: docs(skills-lane): an enumeration row carried under the key-adding exception raises its skill file's token ceiling by its own measured delta
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-tesla"} -->
_Requested by **Tesla** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao?thread=cmsg_01AXsQkLFKRdQCqQ3RTr6Jao2uNTeryhJiTuuLyNf38NhS)_

Fixes #32673

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么:** 把您对本卡裁的 A 写进 skills 车道说明:新增键的 PR 同笔带的那一行枚举,撞上发布 skill 文件的 token 上限时,只按这一行的实测增量抬该文件上限,不删别的、不多抬,PR 正文引两条裁决。token 门禁脚本头部注释与退役手册(改名场景)同步这一条。
- **为什么改:** 不写下来,下一个加键的 PR 会撞红 token 门禁,又不许删 skill 里别的文字,只能停下来再问一次。
- **风险与回滚:** 只改内部指令文本和一段脚本注释,门禁逻辑零改动、不发布。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- **先看:** `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md`(新增那一行与删掉的指针行);`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` §4(改名例外行);`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` 头部新增一段。
- **两分钟验证:** `grep -n "token 上限" .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/lanes/skills.md`,应看到紧挨「枚举行 =」那一行的新条款。
- **需要你做的:** 无,席位落地。

## What changes

Ruling of record: #32673, letter A, maintainer 「32843 32673 同意」 (record 6840575378), executing ruling A on #32584 (maintainer 「同意 A」, record 6819475461).

1. **`lanes/skills.md`**: one clause right after the key-adding exception and the 枚举行 definition: an enumeration row that hits the token ceiling raises that file's ceiling by the row's own measured delta, nothing else in the file is cut, nothing wider rides along, and the PR body quotes both rulings. Grep-able on `token 上限`. Per id-lint, the lane text cites the rulings by wording, not by number.
2. **`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` header**: comment only (no logic change, no new gate). Under "The ratchet discipline", the existing clause "a ruling of record that orders text into a file still authorises its own measured delta" now names the standing enumeration-row case, with both rulings quoted, and states that a rename is the same case.
3. **`.claude/skills/spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` §4** (carrier note 6820982222): the published-skills line said 「另立 `domain:skills` 卡,⛔ 不进退役 PR」 with no carve-out. A new line under that item says a rename whose replacement is a top-level key or bound live member carries that row in the retirement PR, with the ceiling handled per `lanes/skills.md`.

**Paid by deletion, in the same file, with no re-wrap:**

- `lanes/skills.md` (35/35 lines, 0 headroom): deleted the pointer line 「全量判据在 SKILL.md 域车道表;受管面定义与两层分档见 SKILL.md 〈路径分叉〉,⛔ 不另抄。」 This file is loaded from SKILL.md, which carries both the domain lane table and 〈路径分叉〉. The table pointer survives, folded into the header line in the shape `lanes/ui.md` already uses (「范围见 SKILL.md 域车道表…」).
- `spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` (337/337 lines, 0 headroom): deleted the Docs item's sentence 「release notes 在发布时从 changesets + D2/D3 registry 集中编写,你的 changeset(下一项)才是通往它们的输入。」 AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails (`content/docs/releases/` row) says the same: release notes are compiled centrally from changesets plus the ADR-0087 registries, and the PR's input is its changeset and the D2/D3 entries. The item already cites that section, and the Changeset item still follows. The paragraph's remaining text was re-flowed only to close the gap the deletion left.

No published `skills/**` file changes, so no token ceiling moves in this PR.

## Tests

No behaviour changes, so there is nothing to ablate (comment and doc text only).

## Acceptance notes

- Changeset: none. Internal tooling only (`.claude/**`, a script header comment), so this PR takes `skip-changeset`.
- `spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md` table-row pin reports headroom 2 (324 vs 326). That was already there before this PR and has nothing to do with it. Lowering the pin is left to that file's next shrink.

## Verification

Run at head `d7aa2a81` after merging `origin/main` once. `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derived 40 commands for the 3 changed paths, and every one was run locally.

All 40 exited 0 (`dispatch-gates --ran` answers 40 derived, 40 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED). Among them: `pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet` (lanes/skills.md 35/35, spec-property-retirement/SKILL.md 337/337), `pnpm check:pm-skill-id-lint` (113 files clean), and `node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs` plus its `--self-test` (104 cases). `check:doc-formula-expressions` first exited 3 because nothing was measured (lint dist not built). It exited 0 after `turbo run build --filter=@objectstack/formula --filter=@objectstack/lint`.
